To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the threshold current rate of rise in short-term tests is an effective method for predicting the service life of injection lasers.

(1) the use of the short-term test results to predict the lifetime of lasers is a valid approach; (2) the use of a short-term test based on the rate of change of the threshold current is more effective than that based on the initial threshold current; and (3) the aging mechanism is the formation of new centers for nonradiative recombina-tion of carriers.
(1) the service life of injection lasers depends on the initial parameters of the lasers and (2) the service life is determined mainly by the initial rate of threshold-current rise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new generation of injection lasers with a long service life, and with the development of methods for the empirical selection of lasers with a long life.
the study of the influence of the laser parameters on the laser service life.
the study of the aging of the laser structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the laser diode is the most efficient light emitting device in the world.

the service life of injection lasers is determined by the initial parameters of the lasers, and that a laser selected in accordance with the rate of rise of threshold current has a higher probability of being long-lived.

the service life is determined by the rate of the formation of nonradiative recombina- tion centers, and that the rate of formation depends on the initial rate at which the threshold current increases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the feasibility of a high-power laser source based on an injection-seeded, Q-switched, diode-pumped, solid-state laser.
the service life of injection lasers can be predicted by short-term tests.
the service life of injection lasers can be estimated from the initial rate of threshold current rise, and this method gives better results than selection in accordance with initial parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the service life of the laser can be estimated by measuring the threshold current at a temperature of 20-25 °C, and that the service life is not related to the parameters of the initial laser.
the initial slope of the threshold current versus time is a good predictor of long-term reliability of lasers.
, in the absence of a comprehensive theory of aging, the use of the initial rate of change of the threshold current as an indicator of laser service life gives the best results.
